script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: It invents a crowd hanging on Jesus's words as an explanation for the leaders' fear. The passage does not say that.
It places a crowd right there, but the verse does not say a crowd was present.
The claim about Pharisees appearing around Jesus elsewhere in the Gospels needs a reference.
It implies the temple officers were already looking for a way to put Jesus to death. Verse 2 names the chief priests and scribes, not the officers.
It assumes a time when Jesus was teaching would have a crowd around, so it rules out more than verse 6 says. The claim about His teaching at the temple also needs a reference outside this passage.
James is not named for the errand, but saying he gets to sit it out adds what he did.
After identifying Thomas as a disciple, the explanation repeats three ways that he is not named for this errand. It feels mechanical rather than like Papa Dorin.
A furnished room does not establish that Peter and John would not have to bring in anything for the preparations.
The explanation repeats that the room is large without adding much beyond the answer. It sounds flat and mechanical.
Peter and John found things as Jesus had told them, but the passage does not say they had zero surprises.
The claim about the Sabbath appearing elsewhere in the Gospels needs a reference.
The line about the ovens connects the coming of God's kingdom to readiness for the Marriage Supper without a text establishing that connection.
The line about the ovens connects the coming of God's kingdom to readiness for the Marriage Supper without a text establishing that connection.
Exodus 16:35 supports Israel eating manna for forty years, but not the claim that it was bread from heaven. That claim needs a supporting reference.
Saying the temple was right there in the story suggests it was present in the scene. The passage mentions temple officers, not the temple's location.
The passage says they began questioning among themselves. It does not say everyone at the table asked or that none of them knew.
